$comment: Single source of truth for the SharePoint lists backing this app. The runtime field mapping (mapping.ts), the provisioning script (scripts/provision-sharepoint.mjs), and the /sharepoint reference page all read this file.

roster.description: One item per person. Title holds the Title Code — the join key — so it is renamed, indexed, and unique.

fields.note: Built-in Title column, display name changed to 'Title Code'.
Holds the manager's title code as plain text. Kept as text (not a lookup) so CSV imports and writes stay simple; the app resolves the reporting chain itself.

activity.description: One item per visit. Route holds the rep's title code; bare three-digit values get an S prefix on import.

fields.note: Internal name TaskName to stay clear of SharePoint's reserved Task names.
